correctness.rationale: The normalization T(n)=n(n+1)/2 and T(2^k)=2^(k-1)(2^k+1) reduces membership of j below 2^k to 2-adic valuation and 2^k=-1 modulo odd prime powers. Odd k forces each ord_(p^e)(2)=2u with odd u and lcm(u)|k. Explicit small-prime order obstructions exclude every 3-coprime j=4,7,...,40; j=43 has T(43)=946=2*11*43 and local orders 10 and 14, hence exactly k=35 mod 70. Independent sympy divisor enumeration reconstructed ALL 18 intervals k odd 1..35 from integer factorizations and the exact square condition 8d+1 square, then independently computed their incidence Möbius recurrence: mu(2^k)=0 for k=3..33 odd and mu(2^35)=1 on the eight-point lower interval. The infinity of the congruence progression follows from the symbolic order argument, not finite sampling.
residual_risks: The finite boundary relies on complete factorizations and 18 finite enumerations; independently recomputed, not formal proof assistant verified.
No statement on mu_T(2^k) beyond k35 except the divisibility of T(43) for k=35 mod70.
